framesAfterVoiceProcessing.detail: Input-node output format is 1 channel, output-node input format is 2 channels, both 48000 Hz, AVAudioPCMFormatFloat32 (AVAudioFormat.h line 32, rawValue 1). AVAudioIONode.h lines 161-162 require those two formats to be the same before setVoiceProcessingEnabled, and say they can change only while the engine is stopped. The same header does not name an API that picks which channel count to keep. Enable was not called.

framesAfterPlayer.detail: The empty player run is reached only after the no-player engine starts. It did not start, so no second configuration was tried.
